items: ❤️【ULTRA SOFT MATERIAL】 - Made from high-quality washed PU leather, this purse is ultra-soft, comfortable, and lightweight. It's easy to maintain and durable. The smooth and effortless classic zippers add convenience to your daily use. Slim Lining, Strong Durability: Thin but tough for daily use.

❤️【SIZE & STRUCTURE】 -【10.2" Size】 (10.2" x 3.75" x 7.5", 11.05 oz) ---- 【11.8" Size】 (11.8" x 4" x 8", 12 oz). Features 2 main compartments, 1 inside zip pocket, 3 zippered pockets outside, and 12 side pockets. Keep your items organized and within reach with this practical and functional handbag.

items.label: ❤️【VERSATILE】 Everyday and travel crossbody bag
items.value: This fashionable bag can be used as a handbag, shoulder bag, or cross-body bag. It offers a variety of storage options and organization features, making it ideal for travel, running errands, shopping, and everyday use.

items: ❤️【LIGHTWEIGHT & COMFORTABLE】 - Our bag is designed to be lightweight, weighing only 0.3KG - 0.35KG, making it easy to carry without adding extra burden. The shoulder straps are thickened with a 2-layer design, providing a secure and comfortable fit that won't easily slip off

❤️【Great Gift Option】Looking for a meaningful gift? This vintage-inspired shoulder purse with its distressed color and ultra-soft leather is the perfect choice. It's ideal for gifting your loved ones on occasions like Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Christmas, birthdays, or New Year's Day.
